issue.title: print calls should always use report.longreprtext

repository.name: pytest-tldr
repository.description: A pytest plugin that limits the output to just the things you need.

issue.body:
due to https://github.com/freakboy3742/pytest-tldr/blob/master/pytest_tldr.py#L303
we received https://github.com/pytest-dev/pytest/issues/7626

i believe the best solution to prevent that in future is to either use `longreprtext` instead of `longrepr` for printing or to use `totermainal` where applicable

body: Upstream fixed this in the latest pytest-tldr releases

issue.title: Integrate warnings filtering directly into Config

repository.name: pytest
repository.description: The pytest framework makes it easy to write small tests, yet scales to support complex functional testing

issue.body:
Warnings are a central part of Python, so much that Python itself has
command-line and environtment variables to handle warnings.

By moving the concept of warning handling into Config, it becomes natural to
filter warnings issued as early as possible, even before the "_pytest.warnings"
plugin is given a chance to spring into action. This also avoids the weird
coupling between config and the warnings plugin that was required before.

Fix #6681
Fix #2891
Fix #7426
Fix #7626
Close #7649
